catalog.agent_visibility: Complete raw materials, answers and references may be selected for an Environment; the developer controls their use.
catalog.archive_scope: Selected upstream archive; external build dependencies and separately distributed datasets are excluded.
catalog.container_strategy: Store source in controller material storage, preserve provenance, and derive train-only views for dev. Do not expose held-out source through a complete mounted archive.

corpus_contract.code: Extracted compilable C functions and generated supporting declarations.
corpus_contract.oracle: Compilation/crash diagnostics only unless an independent executable harness is admitted.
corpus_contract.split_unit: Original upstream repository and near-duplicate function lineage.

catalog.purpose: Large-scale compiler robustness, compile-time, IR feature and reduction workloads from extracted real-world functions.
qualification_gaps: Compilability does not imply executability, valid inputs, defined behavior or a runtime-speed oracle.
Each original repository license and source lineage must be retained; publication requires provenance review.
Do not count Angha compilation success as runtime performance improvement.
catalog.redistribution_status: Not approved for redistribution before per-component provenance and license review; public availability alone is insufficient.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
catalog.title: AnghaBench compilation corpus

locations.label: Prepared material
locations.purpose: Independent verified source, input, data or upstream distribution.

notes: Definition migration records availability contracts, not successful acquisition, installation or execution.
